_readme: Corporate pump catalogue for Plumb_PumpSelect and Plumb_BoosterSet. Ships EMPTY on purpose: STING does not invent pump data. Add entries from manufacturer curves here, or per project in <project>/_BIM_COORD/pump_catalogue.json (same shape; project entries replace corporate ones with the same manufacturer + model). An entry needs a rated point (ratedFlowLps and ratedHeadM > 0) or at least two curve points. With curve points (flowLps, headM, optional efficiencyPct, read off the published curve) the duty is checked ON the curve at the duty flow; with a rated point only, the result says so. The duty point is written to the pump even when nothing here matches it.
